# VisFurn

VISFURN is a project-door brand offering specification-led door procurement support. The operating legal entity and corporate details should be verified against current registration and commercial documents before contractual use. Based in China, the company supports commercial and institutional wooden door procurement with specification-led quotation review. Buyers can send a door schedule, drawings, quantities, opening information, wall thickness, finish direction, hardware preparation and destination.

## Product lines
- WPC doors — moisture-aware interior door systems for bathrooms, utility rooms and humid project areas.
- Composite entry doors — coordinated entry door systems for apartment and repeated-opening projects.
- Fire-rated steel doors — steel door systems for projects requiring authority-specific assembly evidence.
- Hermetic sliding doors — healthcare door systems for operating rooms, clinical zones and clean corridors.
- Hotel guestroom doors — guestroom, suite and service-opening door systems with frame and hardware coordination.
- School doors — classroom and public-area door systems for education projects.
- PVC interior doors — PVC-finished interior door systems for residential and hospitality openings.

## Service coverage
The website publishes information for buyers in multiple countries. A country landing page does not independently establish completed exports, local certification, or available logistics services. Confirm destination-specific supply capability during quotation.
